name: eddsa_credential_check
description: Verifies an issuer's Baby Jubjub EdDSA signature over Poseidon(subject, claim) without revealing the subject; emits a per-context nullifier

subject.description: Holder identity that the issuer signed off on

claim.description: Public statement the issuer attested to (e.g. Poseidon("isAdult"))

issuerAx.description: Baby Jubjub x coordinate of the issuer's public key

issuerAy.description: Baby Jubjub y coordinate of the issuer's public key

contextId.description: Application / session identifier; namespaces the nullifier

nullifier.description: Poseidon(subject, contextId). Use to detect credential reuse
